summary: Per-tick HUD display manager. Renders the HUD flag overlay first, advances timed HUD messages (message index this+0x0 with a float countdown timer at this+0xDC), expires broadcast messages (index this+0x4), and dispatches the display sub-objects they point at. Then scans an input action map (word_7CB21C, dword_7CB218 entries) to toggle broadcast display (dword_7CF638) and HUD on/off (dword_7CF788), resolving the matching display string through the string table into byte_5EC4CC and rendering it. Ends with a gated audio-device handoff dispatch when this+0xEC is set and the pointer at this+0xD8 is non-null.

local_names.v22: HUD on/off display string formatting buffer

operations.description: Render HUD flag overlay: HUDFlagRendererMain(this) runs first on every tick.
Message display block runs only when this+0x0 != 0xFFFFFFFF (-1, an active message exists) AND global flt_5EA4E8 <= 0.0.
Timer check on this+0xDC (float, init 1056964608 = 0.5f): if <= 0.0 the active message expires; otherwise decrement this+0xDC by dbl_8AFE98 each tick.
Message expiry path: dispatch the sub-object pointer at this+16+4*this+0x0 via VTableDispatchChain_7e00.
When the dispatched sub-object returns 1, clear this+0x0 to -1 and reset timer this+0xDC to 1056964608 (0.5f); when the sub-object pointer is null, clear this+0x0 to -1.
Broadcast message index this+0x4: if != 0xFFFFFFFF (-1) and VTableDispatchChain_7e00(sub-object pointer at this+116+4*this+0x4) returns 1, clear this+0x4 to -1.
HUD on/off state index this+0x8: if != -1, dispatch sub-object pointer at this+12+4*this+0x8 via VTableDispatchChain_7e00 (return value ignored).

Scan input action map word_7CB21C over dword_7CB218 entries; advance until an entry equals 3 (scan terminator) or the entry counter reaches dword_7CB218. An entry equal to 4 is the broadcast-toggle action.

Broadcast OFF branch (flag became 0): call sub_4D8760(-1, 0); resolve aBroadcastDispl_0 via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aBroadcastDispl_0, byte_5EC4CC) and copy it into byte_5EC4CC; format via sub_587DD0(v20, byte_5EC4CC, 127); render TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v20, 3, 16909060).

Broadcast ON branch (flag became 1): resolve aBroadcastDispl via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aBroadcastDispl, byte_5EC4CC), copy into byte_5EC4CC, format via sub_587DD0(v20, byte_5EC4CC, 127), render TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v20, 3, 16909060).
After the action scan (terminated by entry value 3), toggle HUD display flag: dword_7CF788 = (dword_7CF788 == 0).

HUD ON branch (flag became 1): resolve aHudOn via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aHudOn, byte_5EC4CC), copy into byte_5EC4CC, format via sub_587DD0(v22, byte_5EC4CC, 127), render TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v22, 3, 16909060).

HUD OFF branch (flag became 0): call IndexValidationSetter(-1); resolve aHudOff via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aHudOff, byte_5EC4CC), copy into byte_5EC4CC, format via sub_587DD0(v22, byte_5EC4CC, 127), render TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v22, 3, 16909060).

Audio-device handoff: if byte this+0xEC is set and pointer this+0xD8 is non-null, and dword_5EA518 != dword_5EA528 (or the object at dword_5EA528 + 52 != 1), return VTableDispatchChain_7e00(pointer at this+0xD8).
Fall-through return of dword_7CB218 (the input action count).
